title: LED driver schematic
prompt: Capture a schematic for a battery-powered LED: a 2-pin battery, a current-limiting resistor, and an LED in series, returning to the battery's other terminal. Every component pin must be connected to a net — no floating pins, no duplicate reference designators. The schematic must pass an electrical-rule check clean, and its netlist must realize exactly this circuit. Output a .vcad document with the schematic sheet (including its explicit netlist) in the document's schematic field.
